name: Split MEG file [ctf]
summary: Splits a CTF MEG recording into two time segments (for example test and retest) with MNE-Python and saves each as a .fif file.
description: Reads the CTF .ds recording with mne.io.read_raw_ctf and saves two cropped copies: t1min-t1max to the test output and t2min-t2max to the retest output. Use it to cut one recording into two parts for test-retest analyses.

inputs.description: CTF MEG recording (.ds) with BIDS sidecars.

outputs.description: First segment (t1min to t1max) as meg.fif.
Second segment (t2min to t2max) as meg.fif.

parameters.description: Start time of the first segment.
End time of the first segment.
Start time of the second segment.
End time of the second segment.

citations.text: Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
